title: Tierra Viva by Automobili Lamborghini — Benahavís, Costa del Sol, Spain
raw_content:
Tierra Viva by Automobili Lamborghini

Set within the exclusive gated community of Benahavís in Marbella, Costa del Sol, Spain, Tierra Viva is an ultra-exclusive enclave of 53 branded luxury villas inspired by Automobili Lamborghini super sports cars.

Perched on the hills with panoramic Mediterranean Sea views, the villas feature sharp geometric lines, floor-to-ceiling glass, and Lamborghini-branded bespoke interiors.

Villa Typologies:

  • Diamante Villas (6 bedrooms): 4 levels, private swimming pools, rooftop solariums, and home cinema
  • Zafiro Villas (5 bedrooms): Extensive gardens, multi-car garages, and private spa
  • Esmeralda Villas (4 bedrooms): Terraced architecture with direct golf valley panoramas
  • Security: 24/7 guarded private enclave, premium concierge services
